'''Core Foodstuffs''' was a major macro-[[Farm/Legends|farming]] corporation<ref name="Dark Empire" /> that was heavily invested on [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]], an agricultural [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Atlas" /> By [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'' states Core Foodstuffs had been founded by the time of the events of ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'', which ''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]'' dates to [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] agricultural policies had impoverished local [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]], allowing Core Foodstuffs and other agricultural companies to exploit the affected farmers and employ them as virtual [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved labor]].<ref name="Dark Empire" />

==Behind the scenes==
Core Foodstuffs was first mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Michael Allen Horne]] and published by [[West End Games]].<ref name="Dark Empire" />
